summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community highlight ongoing integration efforts with Spark, including the removal of Spark 3.4 support. Additionally, there are proposals for enhancing read restrictions and multi-table transactions in the iceberg-rust project, alongside updates on various Iceberg versions.
highlights: Integration of Iceberg with Spark and removal of Spark 3.4 support
Proposal for finer grained read restrictions in loadTable
Discussion on multi-table transactions in iceberg-rust
